english:
Disabled in the Crucible.

Having 5 or more stacks of Untold Greed improves Elemental Pickups:
• <solar Firesprites /> grant 25% Grenade Ability Energy instead of 11.25%.
• <arc Ionic Traces /> grant 21% Grenade and Melee Ability Energy instead of 11.25%, 27% Class Ability Energy instead of 13.5%, and 2% Super Energy.
• <void Void Breaches /> grant 25% Class Ability Energy instead of 11.25%.
• <stasis Stasis Shards /> grant 36% Melee Ability Energy instead of 10%. This increase is additive with <stasis Whisper of Hunger />'s 60% bonus; the source reports 42.5% Melee Ability Energy per pickup with both.
• <strand Tangles /> deal 350% increased damage. This also affects <strand Whirling Maelstrom />.

Orbs of Power have no discernible improvement.

Reaching Critical Health with 5 or more stacks of Untold Greed consumes all stacks and spawns 4 Orbs of Power for you and allies. Each grants approximately 3.15% Super Energy.

The Orbs launch forward at high speed regardless of whether you look up or down.

// The source labels Firesprite and Void Breach gains as 120% increases, Ionic Traces as 100% Class and 85% Grenade/Melee increases, and Stasis Shards as a 260% increase. Its 42.5% combined Shard gain does not follow from the stated 10% base, 260% increase, and Whisper of Hunger's 60% additive bonus. All reported endpoint gains are retained without correcting the source math. The source suspects the fast-moving Orbs can clip inside walls but does not confirm this.

source.text:
4 Piece | Overflowing Coffers
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

While at x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Elemental Pickups are massively improved.
No discernible effect on Orbs of Power.

Firesprites (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Grenade Energy
Ionic Traces (+100% Class, +85% Grenade/Melee) | 11.25% Grenade/Melee + 13.5% Class -> 21% Grenade/Melee + 27% Class + 2% Super
Void Breaches (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Class Energy
Stasis Shards (+260%) | 10% -> 36% Melee Energy. Additive to Hunger's +60%, totalling 42.5% Energy per pickup.
Strand Tangles | 350% increased damage. Affects Whirling Maelstrom too!

Upon reaching Critical Health while having x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Consumes ALL STACKS to spawn 4 Orbs of Power that each grant ~3.15% Super Energy.
The Orbs of Power are ejected in front of the user at high speeds, likely clipping inside walls.

Looking upwards/downwards does not affect where the Orbs go.
Allied Guardians get the Orbs, too.
